trades.reasoning: Only candidate with full multi-signal confirmation (bullish RSI, MACD crossover, rising histogram, price above SMA-20, and volume surge) indicating genuine institutional participation.

decisions.briefing: Markets were neutral today (NASDAQ -0.5%, S&P 500 -0.4%) with no clear directional catalyst. We added PTGX, the lone candidate showing complete multi-signal confirmation, while holding the rest of our cash reserve rather than forcing buys into weaker setups.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted modestly lower today with the NASDAQ down 0.5% and the S&P 500 down 0.4%, consistent with a quiet, directionless session rather than any single dominant catalyst. Trading volumes and price action suggest investors were largely in a wait-and-see mode. Without a clear macro trigger, individual stock setups like PTGX's strong technical confirmation stood out more than broad market moves.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市普遍回軟，納斯達克指數下跌0.5%，標普500指數下跌0.4%，走勢反映市場缺乏明確方向，屬於觀望性質的淡靜交易日。成交量及價格走勢顯示投資者普遍持觀望態度，未見單一主導消息刺激大市。在缺乏宏觀催化劑的情況下，個股如PTGX展現的強勁技術面訊號反而更為突出。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Signal confluence means waiting until several independent technical indicators — like RSI, MACD, price trend, and volume — all point the same bullish direction before buying, rather than acting on just one signal. This reduces the chance of chasing a false or short-lived move, since multiple confirming signals suggest broader participation behind the price action.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 訊號共振（Signal Confluence）是指在買入前，等待多個獨立技術指標（例如RSI、MACD、價格趨勢及成交量）同時發出一致的看漲訊號，而非僅憑單一指標行動。這樣可以降低追逐虛假或短暫升勢的風險，因為多重確認訊號代表價格走勢背後有更廣泛的市場參與支持。
